WELCOME TO F1 RECORDS OFFICIAL
Welcome to F1 Records Official — your destination for original music, soulful melodies, new artists, and quality audio & video releases.
For the first time ever, actress “Farrhana Bhatt” steps into a new musical journey with her own voice!
Known for her work as an actress, “Farrhana Bhatt” is all set to surprise her audience with her singing debut in “SAHIBA.” A new chapter, a new expression, and a voice ready to share its emotions through music.
